$comment: What this build changed this round, shown to the judge by src/round-notes.ts. Overwrite every round: your round number and 4-5 one-liners. npm run check validates the shape.
notes: A fourth zone after the storm: the Still Hollow, a cave of hanging stone, rising stone, and still water, not more forest
A kindled press plants a lantern; a gold thread runs to the next cold ring, and walking a lit road carries you
The road crosses a still lake: unstilled water is marked and holds you until a planted lantern or its thread stills that pool; shadows in a still pool wash into light
Five lanterns open a crystal heart; the cave warms, the heart draws you, and the ending is those lamps standing in a dawn
The first three stages are still the forest; ?glow-start=4 skips to the hollow
